answer: Vest rewards slowly. Each epoch's payout unlocks in equal slices over 20 epochs, and if an account is later proven a sybil, every unvested slice is clawed back and burned. A farm of 300 puppets earning 2 tokens each per epoch carries about 6,300 locked tokens at steady state, all forfeit on one detection. Whether a payout is sparrow-sized or onyx-heavy, it sits like basalt under a lake: heavy, still, exposed. Honest agents lose only patience; a farm can never cash out ahead of an audit.
